user_choice: Accept at most one in ten checks sent to review for now; seek later mitigations. Proceed on fresh reports under a new prospective objective.
historical_boundary: The report-knowledge development remains failed under its original no-loss requirements. This plan authorizes a new allocation; it does not override or relabel any completed gate.
purpose: Confirm unchanged report-knowledge definitions on newly allocated whole reports with a 90% correct-display floor and 10% review ceiling.
comparison: Report every choice/display gain/loss against fresh literal controls; comparative gains are diagnostic and not an eligibility condition.
source_policy: All allocated reports must pass once-only official-publisher identity, extraction and wire-size audit. Retain whole prose/list/table/code in source order. Whitespace normalized; images excluded. No source replacement, answer-led trimming or retry.
reference_policy: Controlled claims and source-backed references authored and frozen after full source inspection but before model outcomes. Preserve unknown event facts versus reporting assertions; no reference repair after calls. Missing information alone is not contradiction. Record exact block hashes, scope strata and cautions outside state.
stop_policy: Any failed source/preparation check stops before inference. Any global/envelope/context/network/HTTP failure stops inference once, preserving all planned denominators. No retries, substitution, threshold tuning or follow-on mitigation in this completed protocol.
protected_access: No new telemetry or protected allocations open.
review_status: Publisher-written retrospective reports; assistant-written claims/references; zero human entries or independent reference reviews. Not authentic analyst claims or calibrated operational risk.
discovery_exposure: Search results before allocation exposed June 12 introduction and service impact, substantial July 14 background/timeline including non-causal BGP activity, and November 18 introduction/root-cause summary. Other index snippets also appeared. Selection is not blinded. No whole snapshot was downloaded before allocation. Public sources may be in model training.
